# CI-only version pins, applied to every `pip install` in the tests and
# notebooks workflows through the PIP_CONSTRAINT environment variable. They hold
# CI to one JAX build so that a new upstream release cannot change compiled
# numerics between two runs of the same commit. Installs outside CI are
# unaffected: pyproject.toml still declares only the lower bound.
#
# The docs builds (docs.yml, docs-preview.yml) run Python 3.11, for which no
# jax 0.12 wheel exists (it requires Python >= 3.12), so they do not read this
# file. They check that documented listings run, not compiled numerics.
#
# 0.12.0 is the build CI has resolved since 2026-10-20. The tests whose pins
# depend on the XLA build were re-measured against it: the chi2 constant-folding
# control, the GRAHSP ulp and FLOP pins (which keep a baseline per JAX series),
# and the float32 corona floors.
#
# To move CI to a newer JAX, change both lines in one pull request labeled
# `full-tests`, and re-measure any pin that fails before merging it.
jax==0.12.0
jaxlib==0.12.0
# Toolchain versions a green main run (2026-11-07) resolved; Dependabot bumps them.
numpy==2.5.4
nifty8==8.5.7
h5py==3.16.0
chex==0.1.92
optax==0.2.8
blackjax==1.7.1
pytest==9.1.1
pytest-xdist==3.8.0
pytest-timeout==2.4.0
ruff==0.15.6
jupytext==1.19.6
bandit==1.9.4
pip-audit==2.10.1
matplotlib==3.11.2
scipy==1.18.1
